sloka: स एष जाम्बवान् नाम महायूथप यूथपः ।प्रशान्तो गुरु वर्ती च सम्प्रहारेष्व् अमर्षणः ॥६-२७-११॥।।
transliteration: sa eṣa jāmbavān nāma mahāyūthapa yūthapaḥ ।praśānto guru vartī ca samprahāreṣv amarṣaṇaḥ ॥6-27-11॥।।

translations.english: "See this one like a mountain, he is the brother of Dhumra. Even though he is similar to his brother in body form and his valour is great. As such he is superior among leaders. He is called Jambavan, one of valourous deeds, devoted to elders and intolerant in killing."
translations.hindi: इसको देखिये, यह इसका छोटा भाई, पवत की तरह विशाल शरीरघारी है और अपने बड़े भाई जैसा ही रूप वाला दै | किन्तु पराक्रम में अपने भाई से बढ़ कर है
